title: Hot Butter Train
description: Hot Butter Train pulls into the Bell House — a touring variety show with a rotating roster of stand-ups and surprise guests.

poster.credit: Artwork: The Bell House / show organizer
poster.alt: Hot Butter Train promotional artwork.

title: Vanessa Gonzalez's Special Screening!
description: Texas-born Vanessa Gonzalez (Netflix's Verified Stand-Up) tapes her first full hour at Caveat — growing up on the border with a Catholic mother and a witch for a grandmother, finding the nerve to chase her own thing.

poster.credit: Artwork: Caveat / show organizer
poster.alt: Vanessa Gonzalez's Special Screening! promotional artwork.

title: Yankel the Rooster Live!
description: Josh Gondelman (Last Week Tonight, Desus & Mero) heads a Tuesday Bell House bill of six — his clean, story-shaped sets sit well with Flight Club and the rest, and the room at 8pm on a weeknight is one of the easier tickets to land in Gowanus.

poster.credit: Artwork: The Bell House / show organizer
poster.alt: YANKEL THE ROOSTER Live! promotional artwork.

title: Joe Mande Con Amici
description: Joe Mande brings his Con Amici show to the Bell House — the writer-comedian behind Hacks and The Good Place hosting a stacked lineup of friends.

poster.credit: Artwork: The Bell House / show organizer
poster.alt: Joe Mande Con Amici promotional artwork.

title: Laughs In The East
description: Eastville's weekly mid-week stand-up showcase — Brooklyn's oldest comedy club with a rotating lineup of working comics.

title: Christian Finnegan, Paul Mecurio & Friends
description: Christian Finnegan (Netflix, A&E Black & White) and Paul Mecurio (The Tonight Show, CBS The Unicorn) split a Wednesday at the UES club, with Feraz Shere, Rolonda Watts and Olga Namer on the undercard of the room’s rotating showcase nights.

poster.credit: Artwork: The Comic Strip Comedy Club / show organizer
poster.alt: Christian Finnegan, Paul Mecurio & Friends promotional artwork.

title: Molly Kearney
description: Molly Kearney — the SNL and Big Mouth voice behind some of the sharpest character work in stand-up — heads the Bell House with a full hour.

poster.credit: Artwork: The Bell House / show organizer
poster.alt: Molly Kearney promotional artwork.

title: Lisa Wallen Headlines
description: Lisa Wallen — the self-described all-around professional nerd — headlines a single night at Eastville in Brooklyn's oldest comedy club.

title: Chris Gethard: Pop
description: Chris Gethard opens the Caveat stage on his grandfather's story: an 18-year-old left Northern Ireland in 1928, the family he left behind, and the grandson (Beautiful/Anonymous, The Office) asking whether the trade was worth it, a hundred years on.

poster.credit: Artwork: Caveat / show organizer
poster.alt: Chris Gethard: Pop promotional artwork.

title: Brooklyn Power Hour
description: Brooklyn Power Hour is the Friday 6pm happy-hour showcase at Eastville — comics doing early-evening sets before the main room gets going.

title: Poly Díaz (En Español)
description: Poly Díaz does the whole set in Spanish at the Bell House. Go to hear a bilingual stand-up work in his first language, in a room big enough for the crowd to be part of it.

poster.credit: Artwork: The Bell House / show organizer
poster.alt: Poly Díaz (En Español) promotional artwork.

title: Magic City – A Night of Comedy
price_label: $20 + taxes & fees online · $25 at the door
description: DJ Hollywood Deuce and Fat Magic, self-billed “Baby Daddy of Comedy,” bring their Magic City showcase to a 60-seat dry room with no drink minimum. Go for a lineup from outside the usual downtown circuit at a price where $20 really is the whole night.

title: Maria Bamford: Live
price_label: Sold out — see ticket page for returns
description: Maria Bamford lands at the Bell House for a four-night run of new material — a sold-out opening night with 8:30pm and Sunday shows still possible.

poster.credit: Artwork: The Bell House / show organizer
poster.alt: Maria Bamford Live promotional artwork.

title: Wait, What's Sri Lanka? — Comedy Special Taping

title: The Bechdel Cast 10 Year Anniversary Tour
description: The Bechdel Cast celebrates ten years of dissecting movies through the Bechdel test with a live anniversary taping at the Bell House.

poster.credit: Artwork: The Bell House / show organizer
poster.alt: The Bechdel Cast 10 Year Anniversary Tour promotional artwork.

title: Miss Mississippi Comedy: Red State Comics for Reproductive Justice
description: Fundraiser for If/When/How's Repro Legal Defense Fund dressed as a Southern pageant — Jay Jurden, Matthew Broussard and Shalewa Sharpe do stand-up between the tiara bits, and the cause is real.

poster.credit: Artwork: Littlefield / show organizer
poster.alt: Miss Mississippi Comedy: Red State Comics for Reproductive Justice promotional artwork.

poster.alt: Dead Comedian Contest! promotional artwork.

title: Francesca Fiorentini and Matt Lieb

title: Blank Check Live

title: My Cousin Vlad & Balkan Comedy Night
description: My Cousin Vlad headlines with the immigrant-family bits that built his following, joined by Balkan Comedy Night founder Ryan Radusinovic. Go for a bill built around one community’s jokes, told by the people who started the night.

title: Asif Ali Live!
description: Asif Ali (WandaVision, The Mandalorian) headlines the Bell House for a Saturday night set with his own deadpan on the road.

poster.credit: Artwork: The Bell House / show organizer

title: Headlining Alex Giampapa
description: Alex Giampapa headlines the late Saturday room at Eastville — the kind of long, loose set that's earned him a steady pull at the club.

title: Kendall Farrell: Standup Comedy Special Taping

poster.credit: Artwork: Littlefield / show organizer
poster.alt: Kendall Farrell: Standup Comedy Special Taping promotional artwork.

title: Johnny Pemberton

title: Ruby Setnik

poster.credit: Artwork: The Bell House / show organizer

title: Boo-Ha-Ha Comedy Show

title: Chronically Offline
description: West Side Comedy Club's late-Thursday showcase the night before Halloween — a working-comic slot on 75th Street with the room already loose from Boo-Ha-Ha down the line and the weekend pulling people off the couch.

poster.credit: Artwork: West Side Comedy Club / show organizer
poster.alt: Chronically Offline promotional artwork.

title: Laughing Lassi
description: A full bill of South Asian stand-ups from New York and beyond, at 7pm sharp on a Friday in Midtown. Go for a show built around one scene from top to bottom, early enough to leave the rest of the night open.

title: Nasser Al-Rayess
description: Nasser Al-Rayess brings his Habibi Nights tour to Town Hall on Halloween — the stand-up-and-Arabic-music format that's been filling rooms on his dates.

poster.credit: Artwork: Littlefield / show organizer
poster.alt: Scary Good Comedy with Brittany Carney promotional artwork.

title: Health, Mostly Mental: Via Abolencia & Kendall Allison
description: Two half-hour stand-up sets from Via Abolencia and Kendall Allison, both writing from the same place the bar tab comes from: inside the argument about health, money, gender, and the work of staying okay. The double-half-hour is the format — half an hour each, no guest sets, both working on new material, no guests between them.
